## Trade reader

Buyers' own trade label is right for 91.2% of test lots.

Accuracy on the true trade. The blind sets were written by authors who never saw the code or the data; blind-1's first run had no model fallback (it led to it, docs/adr/0005); blind-2 was written afterwards.

| Reader | Simulated test lots | blind-1, first run | blind-2, first run |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| TF-IDF + logistic regression | 99.6% | 61.7% | 59.1% |
| Hashed n-grams (PyTorch) | 99.9% | 63.3% | 60.6% |
| Hashed n-grams + model for unsure lots | – | – | 89.9% |
